code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    background = grid[0][0]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if color == background:
            continue
        for dc in (-1, 1):
            for r in range(h - 1):
                for c in range(w):
                    if grid[r][c] != color or not (0 <= c + dc < w) or grid[r+1][c+dc] != color:
                        continue
                    if r > 0 and 0 <= c-dc < w and grid[r-1][c-dc] == color:
                        continue
                    # Find the complete contiguous diagonal segment.
                    sr, sc = r, c
                    er, ec = r + 1, c + dc
                    while er + 1 < h and 0 <= ec + dc < w and grid[er+1][ec+dc] == color:
                        er += 1
                        ec += dc
                    # Extend both ends of the segment through background cells.
                    rr, cc = sr - 1, sc - dc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == background:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr -= 1
                        cc -= dc
                    rr, cc = er + 1, ec + dc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == background:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += 1
                        cc += dc
    return out
'''
